description: Project Building Resilience and Innovation through Diverse Group Engagement (BRIDGE) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Laura Bray, University of Oklahoma (ou.edu). Project BRIDGE was a community-based participatory research project designed to enhance environmental justice within long-term disaster recovery in Robeson County, North Carolina. The project included interview, focus group, and soil sampling components. Coverage: Robeson County, NC. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: community specialists, participatory research, resilience, hurricane, flood, social science. Published 2023-06-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
